title: Jimmy Dimly is back and we should treasure him while we can | John Crace
summary_full: Old-school Tory with a heart wants to make London fun again – just don’t mention BrexitTories select James Cleverly as candidate for London mayorSooner or later, Sadiq Khan’s luck was bound to run out. Or was it? When he first stood for London mayor in 2016, the Tory candidate was Zac Goldsmith, who was accused of running a racist campaign. Not the brightest move in one of the most multicultural cities in Europe. Not to be outdone, four years later the Conservatives chose the completely anonymous Shaun Bailey. Even Shaun wasn’t sure who Shaun was. Especially when he was quite sure he could have sworn he wasn’t the Shaun Bailey who had an apparent Christmas party during lockdown, which he said “turned into something once I left”.As if to prove it wasn’t an accident that they had previously fielded the worst candidates possible, the Tories came up with Susan Hall in 2024. A politician who makes Liz Truss look accomplished. Her campaign was one of the most joyous imaginable. A wild ride of one idiotic speech to the next. You kept thinking the Conservatives must be having a laugh and would unveil their serious candidate. Only they never did. The only votes she got were from those who had never heard her speak. The Tories would have done better if they had put up a turnip. Continue reading...
